description: This file is an HTML polymer component, specifically a microlibrary script tag, which contains embedded JavaScript code that defines and extends polymer functionalities, including custom element registration, rendering status, and behaviors.

classes.name: Polymer
classes.description: Main namespace object for Polymer framework, responsible for class registration, telemetry, and configuration.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Core class providing foundational behavior, lifecycle, and property management for custom elements.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Removes 'unresolved' attribute from document body once WebComponents are ready.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Calculates and returns configuration settings related to shadow DOM, imports, and custom elements.

methods.name: Polymer
methods.description: Function used to define new custom elements with Polymer, accepting a prototype.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers lifecycle callback, mixing in behaviors and registering the element.

methods.name: createdCallback
methods.description: Initialization called when custom element is created.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Called when a custom element is attached to DOM.

methods.name: detachedCallback
methods.description: Called when a custom element is detached from DOM.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: Handles attribute changes on custom elements.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends a prototype with properties from an API object.

methods.name: copyOwnProperty
methods.description: Copies a property from source to target with descriptor.

methods.name: chainObject
methods.description: Chains an object to an inherited prototype.

methods.name: _addFeature
methods.description: Adds behavior features to the Polymer class/object.

methods.name: _marshalHostAttributes
methods.description: Applies host attributes to the element.

methods.name: serializeValueToAttribute
methods.description: Serializes a value and sets it to an attribute.
